svg.title: Same model, different outcomes
svg.desc: A notebook diagram showing one model and the same task set feeding ten harnesses. One model box (DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731) and one input note (113 DeepSWE tasks, hand-written verifiers) feed three shown harnesses — CodeAF senior-dev with 62 solved at $0.40 per solve, mini-swe-agent with 56 at $0.77, muse-code with 3 at $4.51 — and a zone for the other seven harnesses (codex 51, pi 42, omp/kilo/opencode 31/30/30, claude-code 16, deepseek-harness 16). Footer: cost per solve is model API spend; vendor-run comparison, middle-cluster order inferred.

text.tspan: cost per solve = model API spend
